name: VC Dimension of Singletons
proof: For $n=1$, the class consists only of the all-one concept, so no nonempty set is shattered and the VC dimension is zero. For $n\ge2$, every one-point set is shattered: its singleton labels it one, and any other singleton labels it zero. No pair is shattered, since no concept labels both coordinates one. For $n\ge3$, the zero pattern on a pair also occurs, using a singleton outside the pair.
